note: Every guide in this app is written in our own words. The official names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Where a method is not yet confirmed by any published guide, the trophy is marked UNCONFIRMED in its guide and no method is invented. The game launched 19 November 2026; check these pages for updates as the community confirms more.
